reject: why-tape: 5.10+ ships a tsconfig extending the unpublished ljharb tsconfig, breaking ts-node script-mode runs of tape with TS6053 (verified on 5.10.2); hold at 5.9.x until fixed upstream or the test scripts pass an explicit --project to ts-node

why-types-node: its major must match the Node runtime major in .nvmrc (24); a higher major only weakens type checking (tsc accepts newer-Node-only APIs that crash at runtime); bump together with the runtime

why-typescript: 7.0.2 (2026-09-17) fails npm install with ERESOLVE because the typescript-eslint parser 8.70.0 declares a peer range of typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, and the 7.x package ships Go-built tsgo binaries that make the CircleCI Grype source scan report 16 High Go stdlib CVEs (seen in ml-testing-toolkit-shared-lib); stay on 6.x until typescript-eslint supports 7 and the native binaries are rebuilt on a patched Go
